auto_apply.description: The caller's live auto-apply attempt for this job; absent when none exists.

InboxApplicationDetail.description: The job, the caller's interaction with it, the linked mail and the history.

InboxEmail.description: One message with its body. The internal raw-MIME pointer is not exposed.

InboxLinkTarget.description: Names the application: a catalogue job's slug. Required, 400 when empty.

InboxMessage.description: One row of the listing. `body_text` is sent only when the listing asked for bodies.

hidden.description: How many messages the default filter suppressed.

signal.description: One value from the vocabulary above. (e.g. `interview_invitation`)

slug.description: Link the message to this application at the same time.

InboxTriage.description: The verdict an agent records for one message. Left-out fields read as empty.

Interaction.description:
The caller's interaction with one job. Every timestamp, the stage and the notes are null
until the job is viewed, saved, applied to, dismissed or tracked.

public_slug.description: Stable public identifier. The freehire page is https://freehire.me/jobs/{public_slug}.

url.description:
The employer's own application URL. This is where an applicant goes. Empty when
`direct_apply` is true: that vacancy has no page elsewhere.

direct_apply.description:
True for a vacancy its employer published on freehire that takes applications only on
its freehire page (`https://freehire.me/jobs/{slug}`). Absent for every other posting.

location.description: The posting's own location string, verbatim and unnormalized. Filter on the geography facets instead.

source.description: Origin slug — the ATS or board this posting was crawled from.

external_id.description: The source's own identifier for the posting.

application_deadline.description: Source-stated last application day, inclusive. Absent when the source states no deadline.

manually_added.description: True for a hand-curated posting rather than an automated crawl.

work_mode.description: Absent when the posting's format could not be resolved.

collections.description: Curated collection slugs of the posting's company.

requires_clearance.description:
Present and `true` only when the posting states a government security-clearance
requirement. Absent otherwise — there is no `false`, because "no requirement was
detected" is not the same claim as "this posting needs no clearance".

via_recruiter.description:
Present and `true` only when the posting states that it is published by an
intermediary on a client's behalf. Absent otherwise — a recruiter who never says so is
not detected, so absence does not mean the employer posted it.

equity.description:
What the posting states about equity compensation: `salary_and_equity` (offered beside
cash pay) or `equity_only` (equity is the whole pay). Absent when the posting states
neither — "not stated", not "no equity".

clearance_levels.description:
The security-clearance levels the posting states. Present exactly when
`requires_clearance` is, absent otherwise. `other` is a non-US scheme or a clearance
stated with no level.

perks.description:
Benefits the description states it offers (see the `perks` filter for the
vocabulary). Empty when it names none of them — not a claim that the job offers none.

engagement.description:
The legal terms the posting states it engages its worker on (see the `engagement`
filter for the vocabulary). Empty when it does not say.

auto_apply_available.description:
Present and `true` only when the posting's ATS provider is one freehire's auto-apply
feature can currently attempt to fill and submit for. Absent otherwise — a best-effort
provider-eligibility signal, never a guarantee of successful submission.

apply_questions.description:
How many questions the posting's application form REQUIRES beyond the standard fields
every form asks for (name, contact details, CV, cover letter), counted from the form
freehire captured from the employer's ATS. Optional questions, the equal-opportunity
survey and consent boxes are not counted. `0` means no REQUIRED question beyond the
basics. Absent when freehire holds no form for the posting — "not known", never
"long". Served by search hits and the job detail; a list read straight from the
database may omit it.

created_at.description: When freehire first saw the posting.

last_seen_at.description: When a re-crawl last confirmed the posting was still live.

closed_at.description: Non-null once the posting is no longer open. Only `getJob` ever serves such a row.

enrichment_version.description: Bumped when the enrichment contract changes — use it to detect re-enriched rows.

my_vote.description: The calling user's vote; 0 or null without a signed-in caller.

Job.description: One posting, as every job endpoint serves it.

total.description: The whole closure's open size, even when the list is a capped page.

JobCopy.description: One per-city opening folded under a canonical job.

summary.description: The one synthesized field — a 1-2 sentence synopsis, always present on an enriched posting.

JobEnrichment.description:
Model-extracted attributes, every field omitted when the posting did not state it.
`work_mode`, `regions`, `countries`, `cities` and `skills` are deliberately NOT here —
those are served top-level from the deterministic dictionaries, and the model's own
values for them are not published.

ats_board.description: Whether the URL sits on an ATS board freehire knows how to crawl.

JobFindResult.description: `data` is null when the posting cannot be identified, and then `meta` says whether the board is crawlable.

JobFoundPosting.description: The posting a page URL is, when the catalogue carries it.

level.description: How strongly the evidence reads, e.g. `possible`.

criteria_total.description: How many criteria exist, so `criteria` reads as N-of-total.

contributors.description: Number of independent user reports, once past the disclosure gate.

ats_checked_at.description: When the posting was last looked for on the employer's own ATS. Present only when the `ats_absent` criterion fired.

JobGhost.description:
Hedged "is anyone actually hiring for this" verdict, raised only when evidence fires —
most postings carry none, so an absent value means "no signal", never "verified real".
Attached by `searchJobs`, `getJob` and the plain jobs list. NOT attached by
`agentSearchJobs` or `getSimilarJobs`, so its absence on those two is not evidence
either way.

repost_count.description: How many times this role has been reposted.

mass_posting_count.description: How many near-identical postings the same role cluster holds.

fake_freshness.description: True when the stated posting date looks refreshed rather than real.

JobReality.description: Signals about whether the posting reflects a real, current opening.

notified.description: Only on a decision: whether the reporter was actually told.

JobReportReason.description: The closed reason vocabulary (internal/engage/report validReasons and the CHECK on job_reports).

ignored_params.description: Absent when every param was read.

total_is_lower_bound.description: True when `total` counts only what was read, not the whole match.

ignored_params.description: Absent when every param was read.

total_is_lower_bound.description: True when `total` counts only what was read, not the whole match.

ListMeta.description: A page of a filtered list, with what the filter dropped.

MailFollowUpDraft.description: A chase the candidate sends themselves; `recipient` is absent when nobody ever replied.

MailRecalledEmail.description: One message the recall sweep proposes. `id` is 0 for a message the search found.

MailRecalledPick.description: The message the caller picked out of a sweep. Required, 400 when empty.

MentorProfileSuggestions.description: A prefill for the mentor-profile form, from what the account already knows.

MentorshipBooking.description: One session as a party to it sees it; seeker_email only for the mentor.

MentorshipCalendarStatus.description: `booked`: a confirmed session; `busy`: a synced interval from the mentor's calendar; `free`: offered to seekers; `closed`: outside the stated availability.

MentorshipDirectoryMeta.description: `ignored_params` lists the query params the directory did not read.

seniority.description: Absent when the mentor left it unset.

MentorshipMentor.description: A mentor as the PUBLIC sees them: the directory card and the profile read are one shape.

seniority.description: Absent when the mentor left it unset.

meeting_url.description: Absent while the mentor has not set one.

MentorshipOwnMentor.description: A mentor as their owner sees them: the moderated shape plus the room and the session parameters.

MentorshipProfileStatus.description: The moderation status of a profile. `withdrawn` is a mentor who has left; the row survives it.

job.description: The jobview wire shape `/jobs/search` answers with.

match_percent.description: The share of the posting's skills the given skills cover, 0-100.

OnboardingMatch.description: One matching posting with how well its skills match the given ones.

skills.description: Canonical skill tags, at most 50. They rank the answer; they do not filter it.

query.description: A `/jobs/search` query string (`work_mode=remote&posted_within_days=7`, ...). An unknown param is named in `meta.ignored_params`.

OnboardingMatchesRequest.description: What the onboarding searches with: the CV's skills and the answers as a jobs-search query.

PageMeta.description: Where a page sits in the whole list.

PeriodDate.description: A year, with a month when the CV gives one.

PlanAllowance.description: Usage against a limit for one metered feature today.

amount_cents.description: The smallest currency unit, as the payment provider stores it.

default.description: The price a new subscriber is sold unless they choose another.

PlanSource.description: Where a paid plan was bought.

pro_until.description: When the paid plan lapses, absent on the free plan.

pro_source.description: Where the plan was bought. Absent on the free plan.

PlanTier.description: The tiers a caller can be on.

limit.description: The daily ceiling; with `unlimited`, the fair-use guard behind it.

PlanTierAllowance.description: What one tier allows for one feature in a UTC day.

enforced.description: The features whose ceiling refuses today.

url.description: The job posting URL to parse.

Problem.description:
Every refusal, whatever its status: `{"error": msg}`. `code` is set only where a
client branches on the reason (the auth flows).

location_preferences.description:
What the caller asserted, shaped like LocationPreferences, sent exactly as stored;
null when they set none.

derived_location.description: What was derived from their CV; null when there is no current structured CV.

cv.description:
The contact-free CV, shaped like ProfileCV, sent exactly as the CV store writes it;
null when no current structure exists.

RecentThread.description: A feed row: the thread plus the subject's display names, empty when the subject no longer exists.

ReferralCvKind.description: `original` attaches the uploaded CV; `built` one tailored in freehire.

ReferralIncomingRequest.description: What a referrer sees: the seeker's chosen contact and CV, never their user id.

job_slug.description: Names the vacancy; an unknown slug is a 404. Wins over `job_id`.

cv_kind.description: Which CV to attach: `original` (your uploaded one) or `built`.

cv_id.description:
The built CV, when `cv_kind` is `built`: one you tailored for that opening, or — with
no opening — for any opening at the company (see `cv-options`). Any other CV answers
422.

note.description: A short message to the referrer.

ReferralSeekerRequest.description: A seeker's own request: the target and status, no referrer identity.

url.description: The job page the caller is on; anything not http(s) is a 422.

surface.description: Where the request came from (`extension`, `cli`, …), for the contribution record.

public_slug.description: The catalogue job; null while it is still queued.

ResolvedJobPage.description: Where a job page ended up.

ResolvedJobStatus.description:
What became of the board behind a job page: `found` (the catalogue already carried the
posting), `tracked` (imported, and the board is already crawled), `imported` (imported,
and the board queued for onboarding), `review` (imported, but no crawlable board could be
named) or `queued` (nothing could read the page, so the link went to manual triage).

skills.description: Required and at most 100 once blanks are dropped; anything else is a 400.

ResumeCoverageRequest.description: The skill list a coverage reading scores against the market.

sample_size.description: Only when a single role was named.

skills.description: Only when a single role was named; an empty list is a real answer.

coverage.description: The signed-in caller's own standing against `skills`; shaped like a job match.

skills_geography_scoped.description: Present, and false, only for a single role.

quantiles.description: The salary at every 5th percentile from 5 to 95 (19 values); empty until the rollup has computed them.

breakdown.description: "seniority" when every seniority's bands are returned.

status.description: suggested, confirmed or cancelled. A cancelled meeting is served.

ScheduledInterview.description: One arranged meeting. Unlike an event it can move or be called off.

authorized_countries.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-2 codes the candidate may work in.

privacy_consent.description: A standing agreement to an employer form's privacy terms; false asks each time.

ScreeningAnswers.description: Answers an application form asks for, saved once and reused. Each field is optional.

text.description: The description of the search; refused over the length limit.

previous.description: The result being refined, echoed back from a prior answer.

SilenceState.description: Where an application sits against the silence thresholds of its stage (internal/job/silence).

error_rate.description: Fraction of 5xx responses over the trailing `window_minutes`, from the process's own traffic.

pool_pressure.description: Fraction of the database pool held at once, 0..1. Reported, never judged: it says what the error rate cannot, that requests are unable to start.

SiteHealth.description: The site's own verdict, independent of the ingest fleet's `overall`.

adapter.description: Whether the source is a crawl adapter at all.

jobs.description: Null until a snapshot has been taken for this source.

health.description: Null when no board health record exists.

browsable.description: Null when the search index could not be measured.

StageSuggestion.description: An offer to move the application to the stage its newest classified message implies.

job_slug.description: The minted vacancy's slug; on an approved submission in the caller's own list only.

Submission.description: A submission as the API shows it.

existing_job_slug.description: Set, with every other field empty, when the catalogue already carries the vacancy.

SubmissionPrefill.description: What could be parsed from the URL. Empty when it is not recognised.

SubmissionRequest.description: A vacancy to submit. url, title and company are required; the service refuses a body without them with a 400.

text.description: The whole phrase the row names — the recognised prefix plus the completion, e.g. "Senior Software Engineer Google".

parts.description:
Every part the row applies. Apply ALL of them: a row naming a role and a company that is
applied as only one of the two silently discards what the caller typed.

jobs.description: Open postings behind the completion. Never zero — a suggestion that leads to an empty page is withheld.

kind.description:
Which vocabulary the part comes from, and so which parameter it applies to: `skill` →
`skills`, `category` → `category`, `company` → `company_slug`. A `title` names no facet
and is applied as `q`.

slug.description: The facet value to apply. Absent for a `title`.

text.description: How this part reads on its own.

SuggestionPart.description: One recognised piece of the query: a dictionary term, or text still being typed.

biggest_challenges.description:
Any of `recruiter_contact`, `job_fit`, `remote_flexible`, `working_abroad`,
`visa_sponsorship`, `technical_interviews`, `english`, `first_job`, `just_starting`,
`other`. `just_starting` stands alone. Replaces the stored list. (e.g.
`["technical_interviews"]`)

biggest_challenge_note.description: Kept only while `other` is among the challenges.

current_income_amount.description: What you earn today, in the currency and period below. (e.g. `5000`)

SurveyResponses.description: The onboarding survey. Each field is optional.

TalentCard.description: The anonymised card: only what a dictionary can vouch for.

TalentEducation.description: One education entry: the degree level a dictionary resolved, and the year.

facets.description:
Facet name → value → member count. A count of -1 means the value is present but
held by too few members to say how many; 0 means nobody holds it.

stats.description: Ranged facets. The catalogue has none, so this is always empty.

TalentFacets.description: How many members stand behind each filter value.

timezone_region.description: The part of the zone before the slash; the `tz` filter reads it.

has_photo.description: Whether GET /talent/{handle}/photo has something to serve.

talent_handle.description: The handle in the member's public URL, once they have one.

listed.description: Whether the catalogue shows the member right now.

TalentNetworkVisibility.description: The caller's own place in the Talent Network.

TalentRole.description: One role of a work history, with everything nameable removed.

ThreadCursorMeta.description: `next_cursor` is set only when the page came back full; a partial page is the last.

ThreadStatus.description: A thread is open until a moderator closes it.

ThreadSubjectType.description: The author is the persona handle, "AI" for a system reply or "[deleted]" once the account is gone.

observed.description: The server's verdict on whether somebody other than the candidate set the date.

occurred_at.description: An instant, not a day: which day it falls on depends on the reader's clock.

TimelineEvent.description: One ledger event. An event happened and cannot change.

stage.description: Application stage from the vocabulary above. (e.g. `interview`)

TrackJob.description: At least one of the two is required. A field left out or null keeps the stored value.

id.description: Addresses the row: the posting's slug, or `a<id>` for an application whose posting is gone.

job.description: The job in the shared wire shape; null once the catalogue has removed the posting.

last_activity_at.description: The silence fields are null together on any row that is not awaiting a reply.

auto_apply_status.description: The status of this job's live auto-apply attempt; absent when it has none.

reply_rate.description: The reply-rate benchmark, only when it clears its sample gate.

TrackingPipeline.description: The application count and the count at each stage, zero included.

period.description: The plan day the figures cover, YYYY-MM-DD in UTC.

Usage.description: Today's AI use on the account's own model credential. No money: the plan bounds use.

my_vote.description: The caller's own vote: 1 up, -1 down, 0 none.

CookieSession.name: hire_token
CookieSession.description: Browser session cookie set on sign-in (HttpOnly, same-origin).

PersonalApiKey.description: Personal API key sent as `Authorization: Bearer <token>`.
